description: This file defines a class PsrStream that adapts a Guzzle 5 Stream to adhere to the PSR-7 StreamInterface, providing a bridge between Guzzle's stream implementation and PSR-7 standard.

classes.name: PsrStream
classes.description: Adapts a Guzzle 5 Stream to a PSR-7 Stream interface, allowing seamless integration between Guzzle streams and PSR-7 standard streams.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PsrStream with a GuzzleStreamInterface instance.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the stream position to the beginning.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Retrieves the remaining contents of the stream.
